title: Síntesis formal: evaluar el periodo liberal

sections.content: A balanced historical evaluation needs a formal frame that holds both sides of the argument at once: por un lado / por otro lado sets up the contrast, sin embargo turns from gains to problems, and en definitiva closes with a considered final judgment rather than a simple verdict. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: Por un lado, se lograron avances innegables: la ciudadanía dejó de depender formalmente del origen étnico.
items.english: On one hand, undeniable advances were achieved: citizenship formally stopped depending on ethnic origin.

items.spanish: Por otro lado, sin embargo, conviene no idealizar excesivamente este periodo.
items.english: On the other hand, however, it's worth not idealizing this period excessively.

items.spanish: En consecuencia, algunos historiadores prefieren hablar no de una única modernización liberal sino de varios proyectos liberales distintos.
items.english: As a result, some historians prefer to speak not of a single liberal modernization but of several distinct liberal projects.

items.spanish: En definitiva, el periodo liberal no representó ni una simple historia de progreso continuo ni una simple historia de fracaso.
items.english: Ultimately, the liberal period represented neither a simple story of continuous progress nor a simple story of failure.

sections.content: Ni... ni... (neither... nor...) is the natural partner of en definitiva when your conclusion is deliberately refusing a simple yes/no verdict — it lets you name and reject both extremes in a single balanced sentence.
